# Accounstone

> Outsourced accounting, bookkeeping, and finance solutions for CPA firms and growing businesses across the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia. Service delivery team based in New Delhi, India.

Accounstone provides outsourced accounting support including bookkeeping, tax preparation support, payroll processing, accounts payable/receivable, CFO support, and audit support documentation. Solutions are offered as offshore accounting support, staff augmentation, dedicated accounting teams, and full back-office support, with flexible engagement models rather than one-size-fits-all packages.

## Services

- [Bookkeeping](/services/bookkeeping): Daily transaction recording, bank reconciliation, and financial record management.
- [Accounting Services](/services/accounting): Financial statement preparation, month-end close, and financial analysis.
- [Tax Preparation](/services/tax-preparation): Return preparation support working under CPA/EA review, not independent filing.
- [Payroll Processing](/services/payroll): Payroll processing, tax withholding, and statutory reporting.
- [Accounts Payable](/services/accounts-payable): Vendor management, invoice processing, and payment optimization.
- [Accounts Receivable](/services/accounts-receivable): Customer billing, invoice tracking, and collections.
- [CFO Support Services](/services/cfo-support): Financial planning, forecasting, and executive reporting.
- [Audit Support](/services/audit-support): Documentation and testing support for external audits (does not issue audit opinions).

## Region-Specific Service Pages

Bookkeeping, Tax Preparation, and Audit Support each have dedicated pages for the three core markets, with genuinely region-specific regulatory content (not shared boilerplate):

- United States: [Bookkeeping](/services/bookkeeping/united-states), [Tax Preparation](/services/tax-preparation/united-states), [Audit Support](/services/audit-support/united-states)
- United Kingdom: [Bookkeeping](/services/bookkeeping/united-kingdom) (Making Tax Digital, VAT, Companies House), [Tax Preparation](/services/tax-preparation/united-kingdom) (Self Assessment, Corporation Tax), [Audit Support](/services/audit-support/united-kingdom) (Companies Act 2006)
- Australia: [Bookkeeping](/services/bookkeeping/australia) (BAS, GST, Single Touch Payroll), [Tax Preparation](/services/tax-preparation/australia) (ATO, EOFY), [Audit Support](/services/audit-support/australia) (ASIC, Australian Auditing Standards)

## Industries Served

- [CPA Firms](/industries/cpa-firms): Overflow capacity, white-label work, tax-season support.
- [Technology & SaaS](/industries/technology): MRR/ARR tracking, ASC 606 revenue recognition, investor reporting.
- [Healthcare](/industries/healthcare): Insurance reimbursement reconciliation, payer mix reporting.
- [E-Commerce](/industries/ecommerce): Multi-channel reconciliation, COGS, sales tax nexus tracking.
- [Real Estate](/industries/real-estate): Trust accounting, owner statements, CAM reconciliation, Yardi platform experience.
- [Professional Services](/industries/professional-services): Client trust fund accounting, work-in-progress tracking.

## Company Notes

- Accounstone is a newly launched company; team members bring 24+ years of combined accounting experience.
- The team includes a QuickBooks Certified ProAdvisor (since 2022).
- The company is actively working toward SOC 2 certification and does not currently hold ISO 27001 or SOC 2 certification.
- Service delivery is based at a Global Delivery Center in New Delhi, India, serving clients in the US, UK, and Australia.
